name: Deniz Hamzaoğlu
bio: Deniz Sen Hamzaoglu was born on November 27, 1979 in Istanbul, Turkey. He is an actor, known for Tatli Küçük Yalancilar (2015), Halka (2019) and Aile Arasinda (2017).
